title: Locality of currents: test forms that agree near the support have the same value
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, T ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), ψ, φ ∈ D^n(U) (TestFormOn U n), and let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an open set with spt T ⊆ N. If ψ(x) = φ(x) for every x ∈ N, then T(ψ) = T(φ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ψ φ : TestFormOn U n) (N : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen N → T.support ⊆ N → (∀ x ∈ N, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) → T ψ = T φ
